present_illness.present_illness: The patient complained that the mandible was retracted and the teeth were misaligned since the replacement of teeth, which affected the function and appearance, so he came to our department to seek correction.

past_history.present_illness: The patient complained that the mandible was retracted and the teeth were misaligned since the replacement of teeth, which affected the function and appearance, so he came to our department to seek correction.

oral_examination.oral_examination: The profile is protruding and the mandible is retruded. Bilateral canine molars in neutral relationship. The front teeth have deep overbite of I degree and deep overbite of II degree. There was moderate crowding in the upper dentition and severe crowding in the lower dentition. Poor oral hygiene, red, swollen and hyperplastic gums in the lower front teeth area.

treatment_plan.definitive: Take impressions and take pictures, and agree to discuss the plan next week
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly.

source_handle: 1. Take impressions and take X-rays, and agree on a plan. 2. Take blood tests for the next follow-up visit. Teeth cleaning at the general dental department.
